name: 首钢报警与楼宇控制系统知识库
description: 基于告警系统（alarm_*）和楼宇控制系统（building_control_*）的复杂分析SQL生成规则库

alarm_system.name: 告警系统
alarm_system.description: 告警类别、级别、规则、记录管理

building_control_system.name: 楼宇控制系统
building_control_system.description: 楼宇控制点实时数据与历史数据

alarm_category.name: alarm_category
alarm_category.description: 报警类别表，定义不同类型的报警分类

list_enabled.desc: 查询所有启用的报警类别

search_by_name.desc: 根据类别名称模糊查询
search_by_name.sql: SELECT * FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_category" WHERE "alarm_category_name" LIKE '%{keyword}%' AND "status" = '1' ORDER BY "sort"

count_by_status.sql: SELECT "status", CASE WHEN "status" = '1' THEN '启用' ELSE '禁用' END AS status_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_category" GROUP BY "status"

alarm_level.name: alarm_level
alarm_level.description: 报警级别表，定义报警的严重程度等级

list_enabled.desc: 查询所有启用的报警级别

search_by_name.desc: 根据级别名称模糊查询
search_by_name.sql: SELECT * FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_level" WHERE "alarm_level_name" LIKE '%{keyword}%' AND "status" = '1' ORDER BY "sort"

group_by_color.sql: SELECT "alarm_level_color", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_level" WHERE "status" = '1' GROUP BY "alarm_level_color" ORDER BY cnt DESC

alarm_rules.name: alarm_rules
alarm_rules.description: 告警规则表，定义告警触发条件和通知配置

list_enabled.desc: 查询所有启用的告警规则
list_enabled.sql:
SELECT r.*, c."alarm_category_name" AS cat_name, l."alarm_level_name" AS lvl_name, l."alarm_level_color"
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rules" r
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_category" c ON r."alarm_category_id" = c."id"
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_level" l ON r."alarm_level_id" = l."id"
WHERE r."enabled_status" = '1'

search_by_rule_name.desc: 根据规则名称模糊查询
search_by_rule_name.sql:
SELECT r.*, c."alarm_category_name" AS cat_name, l."alarm_level_name" AS lvl_name
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rules" r
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_category" c ON r."alarm_category_id" = c."id"
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_level" l ON r."alarm_level_id" = l."id"
WHERE r."rule_name" LIKE '%{keyword}%' AND r."enabled_status" = '1'

count_by_category.desc: 按报警类别统计规则数量
count_by_category.sql:
SELECT c."alarm_category_name", COUNT(r."id") AS rule_count
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rules" r
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_category" c ON r."alarm_category_id" = c."id"
WHERE r."enabled_status" = '1'
GROUP BY c."alarm_category_name"
ORDER BY rule_count DESC

count_by_level.desc: 按报警级别统计规则数量
count_by_level.sql:
SELECT l."alarm_level_name", l."alarm_level_color", COUNT(r."id") AS rule_count
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rules" r
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_level" l ON r."alarm_level_id" = l."id"
WHERE r."enabled_status" = '1'
GROUP BY l."alarm_level_name", l."alarm_level_color"
ORDER BY l."sort"

count_by_status.desc: 按启用状态统计规则数量
count_by_status.sql: SELECT "enabled_status", CASE WHEN "enabled_status" = '1' THEN '启用' ELSE '禁用' END AS status_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rules" GROUP BY "enabled_status"

alarm_rule_point.name: alarm_rule_point
alarm_rule_point.description: 告警规则设备点位配置表，定义规则关联的设备、点位及触发条件

list_by_rule.desc: 查询某个告警规则关联的所有点位
list_by_rule.sql:
SELECT p.*, r."rule_name"
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rule_point" p
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_rules" r ON p."alarm_rule_id" = r."id"
WHERE p."alarm_rule_id" = {rule_id}

list_by_device.desc: 查询某个设备的所有规则点位配置
list_by_device.sql:
SELECT p.*, r."rule_name"
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rule_point" p
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."alarm_rules" r ON p."alarm_rule_id" = r."id"
WHERE p."device_id" = {device_id} AND r."enabled_status" = '1'

count_by_operator.desc: 按运算符统计点位配置数量
count_by_operator.sql:
SELECT "operator", CASE 
  WHEN "operator" = '>' THEN '大于'
  WHEN "operator" = '<' THEN '小于'
  WHEN "operator" = '=' THEN '等于'
  WHEN "operator" = '>=' THEN '大于等于'
  WHEN "operator" = '<=' THEN '小于等于'
  WHEN "operator" = '!=' THEN '不等于'
END AS operator_name,
COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rule_point"
GROUP BY "operator"
ORDER BY cnt DESC

count_by_granularity.sql:
SELECT "time_granularity", CASE 
  WHEN "time_granularity" = 'hour' THEN '小时'
  WHEN "time_granularity" = 'day' THEN '天'
  WHEN "time_granularity" = 'month' THEN '月'
  WHEN "time_granularity" = 'year' THEN '年'
  ELSE '未设置'
END AS granularity_name,
COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_rule_point"
GROUP BY "time_granularity"

alarm_record.name: alarm_record
alarm_record.description: 告警记录表，存储所有触发的告警历史信息

list_pending.desc: 查询所有未处理的告警记录
list_pending.sql: SELECT * FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record" WHERE "alarm_status" = '1' ORDER BY "alarm_time" DESC

list_by_time_range.desc: 按时间范围查询告警记录
list_by_time_range.sql: SELECT * FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record" WHERE "alarm_time" BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}' ORDER BY "alarm_time" DESC

list_by_device.desc: 查询某个设备的告警记录
list_by_device.sql: SELECT * FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record" WHERE "device_id" = {device_id} ORDER BY "alarm_time" DESC

list_by_status.sql: SELECT * FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record" WHERE "alarm_status" = '{status}' ORDER BY "alarm_time" DESC

count_by_level.desc: 按告警级别统计告警数量
count_by_level.sql:
SELECT "alarm_level_name", "alarm_level_color", COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "alarm_level_name", "alarm_level_color"
ORDER BY cnt DESC

count_by_category.desc: 按告警类别统计告警数量
count_by_category.sql:
SELECT "alarm_category_name", COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "alarm_category_name"
ORDER BY cnt DESC

count_by_device.desc: 按设备统计告警数量（TOP N）
count_by_device.sql:
SELECT "device_name", COUNT(*) AS alarm_count
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "device_name"
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT {limit}

count_by_status_summary.sql:
SELECT "alarm_status", CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '1' THEN '未处理' ELSE '已消除' END AS status_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
GROUP BY "alarm_status"

trend_by_day.sql:
SELECT DATE("alarm_time") AS alarm_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY DATE("alarm_time")
ORDER BY alarm_date

trend_by_hour.sql:
SELECT HOUR("alarm_time") AS alarm_hour, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY HOUR("alarm_time")
ORDER BY alarm_hour

count_by_category_and_status.desc: 按类别和状态交叉统计
count_by_category_and_status.sql:
SELECT "alarm_category_name", 
  SUM(CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_cnt,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "alarm_category_name"
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC

count_by_level_and_status.desc: 按级别和状态交叉统计
count_by_level_and_status.sql:
SELECT "alarm_level_name", "alarm_level_color",
  SUM(CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_cnt,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "alarm_level_name", "alarm_level_color"
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC

count_by_charge_person.desc: 按负责人统计告警数量
count_by_charge_person.sql:
SELECT "charge_person_name",
  SUM(CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_cnt,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "charge_person_name" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "charge_person_name"
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC

pending_rate_by_category.sql:
SELECT 
  "alarm_category_name",
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "alarm_status" = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS pending_rate
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "alarm_category_name"
ORDER BY pending_rate DESC

resolution_time_analysis.sql:
SELECT 
  "alarm_level_name",
  AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, "alarm_time", "update_time")) AS avg_resolution_hours,
  MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, "alarm_time", "update_time")) AS min_resolution_hours,
  MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, "alarm_time", "update_time")) AS max_resolution_hours
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_status" = '2' 
  AND "update_time" IS NOT NULL
  AND "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "alarm_level_name"

hourly_distribution.sql:
SELECT 
  HOUR("alarm_time") AS alarm_hour,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record" WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)), 2) AS percentage
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY HOUR("alarm_time")
ORDER BY alarm_hour

top_devices_with_high_alarm.desc: 高频告警设备（超过阈值）
top_devices_with_high_alarm.sql:
SELECT 
  "device_name",
  COUNT(*) AS alarm_count
FROM "FWBZ"."alarm_record"
WHERE "alarm_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
GROUP BY "device_name"
HAVING alarm_count >= {threshold}
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC

business_config.name: business_config
business_config.description: 业务配置表，存储系统业务相关的配置参数

get_by_key.desc: 根据配置键查询配置值

building_control_point.name: building_control_point
building_control_point.description: 楼宇控制点表，存储楼宇自控系统的点位当前值

list_by_gateway.desc: 按网关地址查询控制点

get_latest_by_point.desc: 查询某个控制点的最新值
get_latest_by_point.sql: SELECT * FROM "FWBZ"."building_control_point" WHERE "id" = {point_id} ORDER BY "collection_time" DESC LIMIT 1

count_by_gateway.desc: 按网关统计控制点数量
count_by_gateway.sql: SELECT "gateway_adr", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "FWBZ"."building_control_point" GROUP BY "gateway_adr"

building_control_point_history.name: building_control_point_history
building_control_point_history.description: 楼宇控制点历史表，存储控制点的历史采集数据

list_by_point.desc: 查询某个控制点的历史数据
list_by_point.sql:
SELECT h.*, p."gateway_adr", p."bacnet_adr", p."content"
FROM "FWBZ"."building_control_point_history" h
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."building_control_point" p ON h."point_id" = p."id"
WHERE h."point_id" = {point_id}
ORDER BY h."collection_time" DESC

list_by_time_range.desc: 按时间范围查询控制点历史
list_by_time_range.sql:
SELECT h.*, p."gateway_adr", p."bacnet_adr", p."content"
FROM "FWBZ"."building_control_point_history" h
LEFT JOIN "FWBZ"."building_control_point" p ON h."point_id" = p."id"
WHERE h."collection_time" BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}'
ORDER BY h."collection_time" DESC

get_stats_by_point.desc: 查询控制点的统计值（最大/最小/平均）
get_stats_by_point.sql:
SELECT 
  CAST(h."value" AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS numeric_value,
  MAX(CAST(h."value" AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS max_value,
  MIN(CAST(h."value" AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS min_value,
  AVG(CAST(h."value" AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS avg_value
FROM "FWBZ"."building_control_point_history" h
WHERE h."point_id" = {point_id}
  AND h."collection_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
  AND h."value" REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'

trend_by_hour.desc: 按小时统计控制点趋势
trend_by_hour.sql:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(h."collection_time", '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS time_slot,
  AVG(CAST(h."value" AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS avg_value,
  MAX(CAST(h."value" AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS max_value,
  MIN(CAST(h."value" AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS min_value
FROM "FWBZ"."building_control_point_history" h
WHERE h."point_id" = {point_id}
  AND h."collection_time" >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {days} DAY)
  AND h."value" REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h."collection_time", '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')
ORDER BY time_slot

rules: 所有 SQL 关键字使用大写（SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT 等）
表名和字段名使用双引号包裹（Dameng/MySQL 兼容），如 "FWBZ"."alarm_category"
查询时优先使用索引字段（id、外键、状态字段）
状态值：status='1' 表示启用/有效，status='0' 表示禁用/无效
告警状态：alarm_status='1' 表示未处理，alarm_status='2' 表示已消除
时间范围查询时，如果用户未指定具体时间，默认查询最近30天
模糊查询使用 LIKE 并加 '%' 通配符
多表查询时优先使用 LEFT JOIN 关联有外键关系的表
排序默认使用 sort 字段升序，或按 create_time 倒序
统计类查询需要加 GROUP BY，并合理使用聚合函数
占比计算：分子/分母 * 100，使用 ROUND(..., 2) 保留两位小数
Dameng 数据库分页使用 LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {offset} 语法
禁止使用 MySQL/PostgreSQL 特有但 Dameng 不支持的语法
如果用户问题与表结构不明确，返回空字符串或提示信息
告警记录查询默认按 alarm_time DESC 排序，优先展示最新告警

notes: Dameng 数据库兼容 Oracle 和 PostgreSQL 语法风格
字符串连接使用 || 而不是 CONCAT
字符串函数：SUBSTR、INSTR、LENGTH 等与 Oracle 兼容
分页使用 LIMIT {n} OFFSET {m} 或 ROWNUM
表名和字段名建议使用双引号包裹以保留大小写
